data.heading: Week 1 (21 Nov - 27 Nov 2025):
data.text: -  Gradual rise in minimum temperature likely by 2-4 0 C likely over Central India and West India during next 4-5 days and no large change thereafter.

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text:
-  No significant  change  in  minimum  temperature  likely  over  plains  of  northwest  India  for next 24 hours and thereafter gradual fall in temperature by 2-3 0 C during next 6 days.
-  No large change in the minimum temperature likely over rest part of the country.

data.heading: Week 2 (28 Nov - 04 Dec 2025):
data.text:
-  Minimum temperatures are likely to be below normal 2-4°C over most parts of the country except northeast India and Western Himalayan Region, where these are likely to be above normal by 2-4°C during the week.
-  Cold wave conditions likely to occur at isolated pockets of west Rajasthan, south Punjab & south Haryana during some days of the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Wheat: About 128.37 lakh ha area coverage under Wheat has been reported as compared to 107.09 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Rapeseed & Mustard :  About 73.80 lakh ha area coverage under Rapeseed & Mustard has been reported as compared to 69.58 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Gram: About 53.71 lakh ha area coverage under Gram has been reported as compared to 49.30 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
